question.question: Who is the CEO of Everstake?
question.reference: As of the frozen crawl on 13 September 2026, the company page lists Sergii Vasylchuk as CEO and David Kinitsky as CCDO. A June 2025 announcement had named Kinitsky CEO and Vasylchuk President; treat that announcement as historical and do not add President to Vasylchuk's current title because the current roster only says CEO.
question.whyHard: 9 syndicated press copies say Kinitsky 'joins as CEO' (June 2025); majority vote / similarity picks the wrong person
rubric: Every factual claim has a supporting source and correct scope.

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

EVERSTAKE DEVELOPER DOCUMENTATION

OVERVIEW: Everstake provides developer tooling for integrating staking and yield infrastructure into wallets, exchanges, custodians, and fintech applications. All SDKs are production-grade and used by partners including Trezor, Exodus, and Crypto.com.

DOCUMENTATION HUB: https://docs.everstake.com

DEVELOPER RESOURCES:

1. STAKING GUIDES
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/staking-docs/staking-guide
Description: Step-by-step guides for staking on all supported Everstake protocols. Covers delegation, validator selection, reward withdrawal, and network-specific requirements.
Audience: Retail stakers, Developers, Institutions new to staking

2. WALLET SDK FOR STAKING
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk
Description: SDK enabling wallets, exchanges, and fintech apps to embed staking functionality across 130+ supported networks. Provides seamless access to Everstake's staking infrastructure without managing validators directly.
Audience: Wallet developers, Exchange developers, Fintech engineers
Use Cases:
- Embedding staking in a wallet UI
- Adding staking to an exchange product
- Powering staking features in a fintech app

3. YIELD SDK — VAULT INTEGRATION
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk/protocols/hysp-vault
Description: SDK for integrating Everstake's yield vault products (High-Yield Stablecoin Vaults, stVault) into institutional platforms. Provides programmatic access to vault APR data, deposit/withdrawal flows, and real-time on-chain reporting.
Audience: Custodian engineers, Asset manager platforms, Fintech integrators
Try Live: https://midas.app/mevusd

4. SUPPORTED PROTOCOL LIST
URL: https://everstake.com/staking
Description: Full machine-readable list of all 130+ supported staking protocols with current APY, network details, and staking links.

5. SECURITY TRUST CENTER
URL: https://security.everstake.com/

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

answer.question: What security certifications and compliance frameworks does Everstake hold?
answer.text:
According to Everstake's security profile and company profile, Everstake is certified across and complies with six major institutional compliance standards and security frameworks:

1. SOC 2 Type II (Certified; issued by AICPA via Prescient Security audit)
2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Certified; issued by Prescient Security, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls)
3. NIST CSF (Compliant; National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework)
4. ITGC (Compliant; IT General Controls)
5. GDPR (Compliant; General Data Protection Regulation)
6. CCPA/CRPA (Compliant; California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act)

Its independent auditor is Prescient Security.

sources.text:
EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.

International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.

- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy

International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.

question.question: A pooled ETH deposit is confirmed but its validator is not active. Another customer has requested an exit. Explain when Instant Stake helps and whether confirmation alone establishes reward accrual.
question.reference: Confirmation is not validator activation. Matching an existing unstake request can enable Instant Stake; regular entry depends on pool funding and activation. Do not guarantee an activation deadline.
question.whyHard: Do not equate transaction confirmation with immediate rewards.

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

- Fireblocks

- Coinbase Custody

question.question: An operator has 64 validators with 32 ETH each. Using Everstake’s Pectra explanation, what consolidation fits the new effective-balance cap, and did the minimum validator stake rise to that cap?
question.reference: 64 × 32 = 2,048 ETH, fitting one validator at the new effective-balance cap. This changes the maximum, not the 32 ETH validator minimum.
question.whyHard: Do not infer that every operator must stake 2,048 ETH or that consolidation is automatically completed.

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

question.question: Everstake’s CFO guide limits operator-failure loss to missed rewards, yet also describes slashing of principal. Can a treasury conclude that retaining withdrawal control makes its principal immune to operator mistakes?
question.reference: No. The guide contains a material qualification: non-custodial control and validator-signing risk differ. Slashing can affect principal. Public terms disclose risk; private indemnities require their own evidence.
question.whyHard: Do not claim a real slashing incident occurred or determine a customer’s contractual entitlement.

sources.text:
EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

EVERSTAKE INTEGRATIONS

OVERVIEW: Everstake integrates natively with all major institutional custody platforms, wallet providers, and developer frameworks. Staking and yield products can be added to your stack without changing internal custody, reporting, or compliance workflows.

CUSTODY PLATFORM INTEGRATIONS:

1. FIREBLOCKS (MPC Custody) - Enterprise Ready
Native integration enabling institutions to stake directly from Fireblocks custody without moving assets. Supports all major PoS networks.
Website: https://www.fireblocks.com

2. BITGO (Qualified Custodian) - Enterprise Ready
Staking integration for BitGo-custodied assets across Everstake-supported networks.
Website: https://www.bitgo.com

3. ANCHORAGE DIGITAL (Federally Chartered Digital Asset Bank) - Enterprise Ready
Integration enabling Anchorage Digital clients to access Everstake staking infrastructure.
Website: https://www.anchorage.com

4. ZODIA CUSTODY (Institutional Custodian) - Enterprise Ready
Staking access for Zodia Custody-held assets via Everstake's non-custodial validator infrastructure.
Website: https://zodia.io

5. COPPER.CO (Digital Asset Custodian) - Enterprise Ready
Integration enabling Copper.co clients to stake without changing custody arrangements.
Website: https://copper.co

6. COINBASE CUSTODY (Qualified Custodian) - Enterprise Ready
Staking integration for Coinbase Custody clients across Everstake-supported protocols.
Website: https://www.coinbase.com/prime/custody

7. SAFE (formerly Gnosis Safe) - Multi-sig/Smart Contract Wallet - Enterprise Ready
Multi-sig wallet integration enabling DAOs, protocols, and institutions to stake from Safe wallets.
Website: https://safe.global

WALLET & PLATFORM PARTNERSHIPS:

1. TREZOR (Hardware Wallet)
Hardware-wallet-native staking across major PoS networks, powered by Everstake. Enabled via Staking-as-a-Service integration.
Case Study: https://everstake.com/assets/pdf/caseStudies/everstake-supports-trezor-in-integrating-staking-as-a-service-2026.pdf

2. EXODUS (Software Wallet)
Everstake powers staking rewards for Exodus users, enabling secure and effortless earning on held assets.

3. CRYPTO.COM (Exchange/Platform)
Everstake provides validator infrastructure for Crypto.com's staking services.

DEVELOPER SDKs:

1. WALLET SDK FOR STAKING
SDK for embedding staking across 130+ networks into wallets, exchanges, and fintech apps.
Documentation: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk
Suitable For: Wallets, Exchanges, Fintech apps, Card programs

2. YIELD SDK — VAULT INTEGRATION
SDK for integrating Everstake yield vault products (stablecoin vaults, stVault) into institutional platforms.
Documentation: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk/protocols/hysp-vault
Suitable For: Custodians, Asset managers, Banks, Fintech platforms

INTEGRATION INQUIRY: https://everstake.com/contact-us

NOTE: Custom integration models available for institutional and enterprise partners. Contact Everstake for bespoke deployment architectures.

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

question.question: Direct Shreds advertises 3ms p50 in-region. A client runs far from the validator and requires every message within 3ms. Does the advertised measurement establish that guarantee?
question.reference: No. The stated figure is an in-region median, not an all-message upper bound or cross-region SLA. Listener placement and network distance matter.

OVERVIEW: Everstake provides developer tooling for integrating staking and yield infrastructure into wallets, exchanges, custodians, and fintech applications. All SDKs are production-grade and used by partners including Trezor, Exodus, and Crypto.com.

DOCUMENTATION HUB: https://docs.everstake.com

DEVELOPER RESOURCES:

1. STAKING GUIDES
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/staking-docs/staking-guide
Description: Step-by-step guides for staking on all supported Everstake protocols. Covers delegation, validator selection, reward withdrawal, and network-specific requirements.
Audience: Retail stakers, Developers, Institutions new to staking

2. WALLET SDK FOR STAKING
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk
Description: SDK enabling wallets, exchanges, and fintech apps to embed staking functionality across 130+ supported networks. Provides seamless access to Everstake's staking infrastructure without managing validators directly.
Audience: Wallet developers, Exchange developers, Fintech engineers
Use Cases:
- Embedding staking in a wallet UI
- Adding staking to an exchange product
- Powering staking features in a fintech app

3. YIELD SDK — VAULT INTEGRATION
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk/protocols/hysp-vault
Description: SDK for integrating Everstake's yield vault products (High-Yield Stablecoin Vaults, stVault) into institutional platforms. Provides programmatic access to vault APR data, deposit/withdrawal flows, and real-time on-chain reporting.
Audience: Custodian engineers, Asset manager platforms, Fintech integrators

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

question.question: A QUIC connection authenticates with allowlisted key A, but the submitted transaction is signed by wallet B. Does the published SWQOS API require A to sign that transaction, and is the tip optional?
question.reference: The allowlisted QUIC key authenticates transport and need not sign the submitted transaction. The current product docs are internally inconsistent on tips: they say both paths require a tip of at least 1,000,000 lamports, but also say a transaction without a tip rides one SWQOS path without fanout or a priority boost. Report that conflict. The frozen corpus contains no copy of the linked repository README, so it cannot establish a prepaid-customer exception.
question.whyHard: Do not treat the tip as universally optional or universally mandatory across all plans; do not require the transport key to sign the transaction.
rubric: Do not treat the tip as universally optional or universally mandatory across all plans; do not require the transport key to sign the transaction.

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

sources.text:
EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

5. COPPER.CO (Digital Asset Custodian) - Enterprise Ready
Integration enabling Copper.co clients to stake without changing custody arrangements.

Staking integration for Coinbase Custody clients across Everstake-supported protocols.

Multi-sig wallet integration enabling DAOs, protocols, and institutions to stake from Safe wallets.

WALLET & PLATFORM PARTNERSHIPS:

1. TREZOR (Hardware Wallet)
Hardware-wallet-native staking across major PoS networks, powered by Everstake. Enabled via Staking-as-a-Service integration.
Case Study: https://everstake.com/assets/pdf/caseStudies/everstake-supports-trezor-in-integrating-staking-as-a-service-2026.pdf

2. EXODUS (Software Wallet)
Everstake powers staking rewards for Exodus users, enabling secure and effortless earning on held assets.

3. CRYPTO.COM (Exchange/Platform)
Everstake provides validator infrastructure for Crypto.com's staking services.

DEVELOPER SDKs:

1. WALLET SDK FOR STAKING
SDK for embedding staking across 130+ networks into wallets, exchanges, and fintech apps.
Documentation: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk
Suitable For: Wallets, Exchanges, Fintech apps, Card programs

2. YIELD SDK — VAULT INTEGRATION
SDK for integrating Everstake yield vault products (stablecoin vaults, stVault) into institutional platforms.
Documentation: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk/protocols/hysp-vault
Suitable For: Custodians, Asset managers, Banks, Fintech platforms

INTEGRATION INQUIRY: https://everstake.com/contact-us

NOTE: Custom integration models available for institutional and enterprise partners. Contact Everstake for bespoke deployment architectures.

question.question: What is the exact monthly SWQOS Pro bill including London and Dublin QUIC add-ons, all transaction tips, and any minimum commitment?

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

EVERSTAKE DEVELOPER DOCUMENTATION

OVERVIEW: Everstake provides developer tooling for integrating staking and yield infrastructure into wallets, exchanges, custodians, and fintech applications. All SDKs are production-grade and used by partners including Trezor, Exodus, and Crypto.com.

DOCUMENTATION HUB: https://docs.everstake.com

DEVELOPER RESOURCES:

1. STAKING GUIDES
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/staking-docs/staking-guide
Description: Step-by-step guides for staking on all supported Everstake protocols. Covers delegation, validator selection, reward withdrawal, and network-specific requirements.
Audience: Retail stakers, Developers, Institutions new to staking

2. WALLET SDK FOR STAKING
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk
Description: SDK enabling wallets, exchanges, and fintech apps to embed staking functionality across 130+ supported networks. Provides seamless access to Everstake's staking infrastructure without managing validators directly.
Audience: Wallet developers, Exchange developers, Fintech engineers
Use Cases:
- Embedding staking in a wallet UI
- Adding staking to an exchange product
- Powering staking features in a fintech app

3. YIELD SDK — VAULT INTEGRATION
URL: https://docs.everstake.com/integrations/everstake-products/wallet-sdk/protocols/hysp-vault

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe

CERTIFICATION REPORTS: Full certification reports available upon request — contact https://everstake.com/contact-us

EVERSTAKE SECURITY PROFILE

OVERVIEW: Everstake is the only major validator operator certified across all six institutional compliance standards simultaneously. Our globally distributed bare-metal infrastructure, multi-cloud architecture, and audited security frameworks deliver the uptime, transparency, and operational clarity required by institutional teams that cannot afford uncertainty.

TRUST CENTER: https://security.everstake.com/
REPORT VULNERABILITY: https://everstake.com/report-vulnerability
AUDITOR: Prescient Security — Global Top 20 Independent Audit and Penetration Testing Company

KEY DIFFERENTIATOR: Everstake is the only validator operator certified across all six major institutional compliance standards: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA — simultaneously.

CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE:

1. SOC 2 TYPE II - CERTIFIED
Validates that Everstake maintains high levels of operational integrity, data confidentiality, and system availability. Type II involves continuous evaluation of systems over time — one of the most rigorous benchmarks in enterprise-grade cybersecurity.
Covers: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy
Issued by: AICPA (via Prescient Security audit)
Significance: Required by most US enterprise and institutional buyers as prerequisite for security review

2. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - CERTIFIED
International gold standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Confirms Everstake's ISMS complies with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, covering 93 prescribed Annex A security controls.
Issued by: Prescient Security
Significance: Global gold standard for ISMS — critical for non-US institutional and regulated entity buyers

3. NIST CSF - COMPLIANT
National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework — widely adopted US federal and enterprise standard covering Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Significance: Aligned with US government and critical infrastructure security expectations

4. ITGC - COMPLIANT
IT General Controls — standard controls covering access management, change management, computer operations, and IT infrastructure that underpin reliable financial and operational reporting.
Significance: Required for integration with regulated financial institutions and audit trails

5. GDPR - COMPLIANT
General Data Protection Regulation — ensures Everstake adheres to the strictest data privacy protocols for users in the EU, EEA, and UK.
Significance: Mandatory for any provider handling European client data

6. CCPA/CRPA - COMPLIANT
California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act — US data privacy compliance for California residents.
Significance: Required for providers operating with US-based clients and data subjects

INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY:
- Architecture: Geo-distributed bare-metal infrastructure with multi-cloud architecture
- Validator isolation: Isolated validator clusters per deployment
- Failover: Automated failover with continuous performance monitoring
- Monitoring: 24/7 continuous monitoring across all validators and networks
- Slashing record: Zero material slashing events since inception (2018)
- Uptime: 99.98% observed infrastructure uptime

OPERATIONAL CONTROLS:
- Strict operational controls and continuous system validation
- Documented security controls aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A
- Regular independent penetration testing
- Smart contract audits (e.g. ETH2 Batch Deposit Contract audited by Ackee Blockchain Security)
- Continuous control monitoring and improvement programme

CUSTODY PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY:
Non-custodial by design with seamless integration support for:
- Fireblocks
- BitGo
- Anchorage Digital
- Zodia Custody
- Coinbase Custody
- Copper.co
- Safe
